title: Learning objectives, data, tasks, and evaluation
approval: Author-agent design review, 2026-09-08; scientific acceptance remains pending.

figures.title: Five objects that must not be conflated
figures.readerQuestion: Where does a result get its meaning?
figures.mechanism: Dataset; task; objective; model; evaluation protocol
figures.sequence: Fix allowed input and target; train; predict; evaluate against untouched examples
figures.captionThesis: A score is conditional on the whole protocol.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: No arrow from a score directly to architectural superiority.

figures.title: One base string, several prediction units
figures.readerQuestion: How does tokenization change the question?
figures.mechanism: Base tokens; overlapping k-mers; nonoverlapping chunks; BPE units
figures.sequence: Track shared bases and target shift; expose next-token shortcuts
figures.evidenceSource: Original example; DNABERT-2 and HyenaDNA tokenization anchors
figures.captionThesis: Token NLL is not automatically comparable across tokenizers.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Overlapping k-mers share most of the next target.

figures.title: Split biological relationships, not just rows
figures.readerQuestion: Why can disjoint record IDs still leak?
figures.mechanism: Duplicate/reverse-complement records; metadata groups; connected components; folds
figures.sequence: Build conflict graph; union transitive groups; assign whole components
figures.evidenceSource: Original exact-group algorithm; SpanSeq; DataSAIL abstract
figures.captionThesis: The declared grouping relation determines what separation guarantees.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Exact reverse-complement grouping does not detect homology.

figures.title: Teacher forcing without a future shortcut
figures.mechanism: Input prefix positions; next-base targets; causal dependence mask
figures.sequence: Shift targets once; retain prefix; prohibit information from later inputs
figures.captionThesis: Output at input position t predicts x at t+1.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Testing prefix invariance cannot detect a mis-shifted target alone.

figures.title: Change the future, then compare the past outputs
figures.readerQuestion: How do we catch an information leak directly?
figures.mechanism: Original sequence; changed suffix; legal model; deliberately leaky control
figures.sequence: Clone; alter suffix; compare all prefix logits; repeat split points
figures.evidenceSource: Existing evo_torch causality helper plus new reference controls
figures.captionThesis: A finite intervention is behavioral evidence, not a universal proof.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: One suffix edit can miss invariance-specific leakage; tolerance must reject NaN.

figures.title: Random targets set an information floor
figures.mechanism: Uniform DNA source; expected log loss; finite sample; memorized training set
figures.sequence: Derive H+KL; convert nats to bits and perplexity; separate expectation from sample
figures.evidenceSource: Original derivation; Zhang et al. random-label fitting anchor
figures.captionThesis: Independent fresh targets give expected NLL at least ln 4.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: A finite test score can fluctuate; repeated evaluation is not untouched evidence.

figures.title: Equal parameter totals can hide different resources
figures.readerQuestion: Which variables did the comparison actually hold fixed?
figures.mechanism: Width; depth; state; KV; FFN; tokens; compute
figures.sequence: Compute exact toy parameter totals; compare other dimensions
figures.evidenceSource: Original parameter accounting; Chapter 1 memory contract
figures.captionThesis: Matching one budget defines one question, not complete fairness.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Parameter count is not an effective-capacity theorem.

figures.title: Three runs are not one typical run
figures.mechanism: Individual values 0.51,0.97,0.99; mean; spread; paired runs
figures.sequence: Display every point; summarize; separate seed and test-sample uncertainty
figures.evidenceSource: Illustrative values supplied in brief; Bouthillier et al.
figures.captionThesis: A wide three-point sample warrants diagnosis, not a confident mode claim.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Do not label supplied illustrative values as measured training results.

figures.title: Exact task semantics precede training
figures.readerQuestion: What must a delay benchmark really remember?
figures.mechanism: Sequence; lag; scored positions; oracle; shortcut control
figures.sequence: Compute delayed targets; vary lags and lengths; compare constant/current-token predictors
figures.captionThesis: An oracle makes correctness testable before learning begins.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: A high score on correlated inputs may not establish delayed memory.

figures.title: A balanced memory task matrix
figures.mechanism: Delay/retrieval; parity/sum; key-value lookup; pointer chasing; motifs; routing
figures.sequence: Specify oracle and shortcut for each; balance addressable history and sufficient statistics
figures.evidenceSource: Original benchmark design; established model-family anchors
figures.captionThesis: Compare different memory demands under declared budgets.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Synthetic extrapolation is not general intelligence or biological function.

figures.title: Removal and transplant answer different questions
figures.readerQuestion: Is the effect due to a mechanism or the whole package?
figures.mechanism: Full model; matched removal; baseline; transplanted mechanism
figures.sequence: Define metric direction; compare paired effects; retain data/tuning controls
figures.captionThesis: An ablation effect is conditional on the changed training system.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Removing a component also changes optimization, capacity and runtime.

figures.title: Quality and execution are separate axes
figures.readerQuestion: Can a model be better and an engine be wrong?
figures.mechanism: Cross entropy; accuracy/F1; calibration; latency; throughput; memory; parity
figures.sequence: Report quality/resource vector; independently compare engine outputs to reference
figures.evidenceSource: Original metric definitions; Guo calibration; PyTorch loss
figures.captionThesis: A Pareto comparison is not a single unexplained winner.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Toy timings are not production performance.

figures.title: The experiment record is an executable boundary
figures.readerQuestion: How does a prespecified question become evidence?
figures.mechanism: Researcher; existing experiment spec; smoke runner; evaluator; result artifact
figures.sequence: Lock spec hash; run deterministic checks; emit results and limitations
figures.evidenceSource: EVO-EXP01 existing repository plan and new smoke record
figures.captionThesis: A completed smoke test does not mean the model research experiment is complete.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: UML return arrows must not imply training or external review occurred.
